title: Reports Say Cuts to Federal Research Funding Would Seriously Harm the American Economy
paragraphs: In a recent analysis of data collected by the National Center for Science and Engineering Statistics, The New York Times found that “in fiscal year 2023 alone, roughly $60 billion flowed from the federal government to universities in all 50 states, funding research on an array of topics, like cancer, Alzheimer’s disease and rare isotope beams.”
